item.title: Foundations of a Successful Outreach Strategy
item.description:
In this solo episode, Pranoti Kshirsagar shares the three foundational pillars of a successful outreach strategy for a research project — drawn from real work on the QuanTour campaign, a year-long global science outreach initiative following a quantum light source across 12 labs in 12 months.

Pillar 1: Define and align Before creating any content, ask: who is this for, and why now? For QuanTour, this meant building an audience curious about quantum science beyond just specialists, spotlighting the scientists and labs involved, and partnering with science societies and universities to amplify reach and credibility.
